title: Grateful Dead Live at Star Theatre on 1970-03-08
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > CD > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with good clarity; the show shines on Black Peter, Lovelight and a fiery Hard‑to‑Handle despite an intrusive guest vocalist.
ai_review.review: The recording is a generally clear sound‑board source that remains listenable even when the surprise on‑stage singer drives the volume up. Musically the band delivers strong performances – Jerry’s acoustic Black Peter solo, a soaring Lovelight and a punchy Hard‑to‑Handle stand out – while the guest’s chaotic contributions mar Not Fade Away and the impromptu blues segment.

ai_rating.rationale: Average user rating ~3.5, but most comments praise the music and note decent sound quality; a few strong negative reactions to the guest keep the overall sentiment from being fully positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and listenable; occasional volume fluctuations when the unknown vocalist takes over, but no major drop‑outs or distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set builds through a solid acoustic segment, a memorable Lovelight transition and energetic rock numbers; the surprise guest interrupts Not Fade Away and the impromptu blues but the band keeps tight footing throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice described as sweet, musical and heartbreakingly passionate on Black Peter; acoustic solo praised.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals called crystal clear by several reviewers.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drumming noted as tight and solid.
